heading:
Come work with us
in Lake Toya
description: We are always looking for hotel staff.
We're waiting for teammates who want to work together, surrounded by the lakeside scenery and our guests' smiles.

workLife.heading: Working at a lakeside hotel in Lake Toya Onsen
workLife.description: A 39-room hotel standing right in front of the sightseeing boat pier. Our 16 staff members work together, putting smiles first as we welcome our guests. We have hired senior staff, staff from overseas, and people relocating from cities to the countryside, and people of all backgrounds are thriving here.
points: Great location right by the sightseeing boat pier — about a 15-minute drive to commute
Small team of 16 staff with an emphasis on teamwork
Seniors and those with no experience are welcome (we train carefully)
Track record of hiring staff from overseas / open to relocation from other regions
Uniforms provided (white coats, work jackets, kimono, etc. depending on department)

photos.alt: Hotel Grand Toya in Lake Toya Onsen

positionsDescription: We are currently hiring for the following positions. Applicants with no experience are welcome to apply.

positions.title: Kitchen Staff
positions.summary: This role supports cooking tasks such as rice preparation, dishwashing, and plating in the hotel kitchen. No experience necessary.
duties: Kitchen cleaning and other general duties
positions.holidays: Shift-based, two days off per week | 87 days off per year
tags: 15 min. by car from the station

positions.title: Guest Room Attendant
positions.summary: This role covers guiding guests to their rooms, serving and clearing meals, and cleaning guest rooms. You'll work as part of a 5-7 person team, and those with no experience will be carefully trained.
positions.holidays: Shift-based, two days off per week | 87 days off per year
tags: 15 min. by car from the station

image.alt: Staff serving guests at the front desk

positions.title: Front Desk Staff
positions.summary: This role covers front desk duties during the hours between check-out and check-in. Mainly guest service, phone handling, and basic data entry — days and hours are negotiable.
tags: 15 min. by car from the station

processDescription: Here's what happens from application to joining us.

process.title: Apply
process.description: Feel free to contact us by email or phone. We'll ask you to send a resume with a photo.

process.title: Document screening
process.description: We review your resume as part of the initial screening.

process.title: Interview
process.description: Interviews are usually held once, on a rolling basis. We'll arrange a date together.

process.title: Result notice
process.description: We'll contact you by phone, mail, or email, usually within 7 days of the interview.

process.title: Joining us
process.description: After joining, a senior staff member will carefully walk you through your duties, so no experience is needed.

benefits.label: Full social insurance (employment, workers' comp, health, pension)
Commuting by car OK, parking available
Track record of hiring staff from overseas / open to relocation from other regions
